title: Zesty Smoky Egyptian Rocket Wrap
description: A smoky and romantic Egyptian dish featuring rocket, wrapped in a ssam-wrap and cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven, this recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and perfect for a dinner date
instructions: Preheat the Dutch oven over medium heat
In a small bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper
Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat with the smoky mixture
Add the rocket leaves to the Dutch oven and cook until wilted
Add the chickpeas to the Dutch oven and stir to combine with the rocket leaves
Warm the ssam-wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds
Assemble the wraps by spooning the rocket and chickpea mixture onto a ssam-wrap piece and serving immediately
Garnish with additional rocket leaves and lemon wedges if desired
